posts.title: Guidelines for Development Tools
posts.description: When it comes to my development environment, I tend to have a couple simple philosophies that guide what tools I use.

posts.title: Version Control for English (and other Natural Languages)
posts.description: As some folks might know, my degree is not in Computer Science, but in English Creative Writing. When I was doing workshops in university, my professors and classmates all used Word and many of them used the built-in version control feature to version their documents. This was, and still is, a need that has been poorly anticipated, but with a little context, it makes sense.

posts.title: Tips and Tricks for Password Generation
posts.description: If you are anything like me, you probably have a lot of different places you need to log in with a username and password. Hopefully you are using a password manager to keep track of all of them so you don’t have to. My preferred option is 1Password; while it’s not free, I have great confidence in their security and for the value I get it’s some of the best money I pay.
